name: iso5167_orifice_plate_flow_rate
title: ISO 5167 orifice plate (diaphragm) flow-rate calculation
summary: ISO 5167-1980 flow-rate procedure for a diaphragm (orifice plate with corner tappings): fluid properties at the upstream state (humid air supported), Stolz discharge coefficient and expansibility factor; the default operating point is written inversely and solves the bore diameter from an imposed mass flow rate.
